method: Downloaded every listed file in the Higgsfield sandbox; numbers from ffprobe/ffmpeg (ebur128) + numpy/scipy (onset autocorrelation BPM, Krumhansl-Schmuckler key on chroma, RMS envelopes). Nothing was listened to. Evidence for each licence was read on the page named in evidence_url.

field_notes.trim_points_s: in = first audible sample (or the recommended usable segment start for drones/pads/stings); out = last audible sample with the silent tail removed (or segment end). Beat-grid downbeats are in bar_grid.first_downbeat_s.
field_notes.loop_points_s: best 8- or 16-bar loop candidate by spectral/energy similarity of the bars around the join; smaller distance = smoother join (typical pair distance is 1-2); unverified by ear.
field_notes.cut_points_s: beat tracks: first downbeat, then section boundaries (largest bar-group changes) snapped to the bar grid, then last audible sample. Beatless tracks: energy minima at least 8 s apart. Stings: the hit/peak time. Drones/pads: recommended segment start and end.
field_notes.url_check: each direct URL was fetched with a ranged GET (bytes 0-2047, HTTP 200/206) on 2026-09-29 and the full file was downloaded for analysis
field_notes.energy_10s_dbfs: 5-s RMS (dBFS) sampled every 10 s from t=0 (analysis window capped at 300-400 s)
field_notes.bpm: null = beatless/not applicable; bpm_confidence high = autocorrelation agrees with the catalog value (<=2.5%) and the peak is >=4x the baseline, or (no catalog value) >=7x with a stable comb fit; low = conflicting or weak periodicity
field_notes.key_guess: Krumhansl-Schmuckler on a log-compressed chroma; r is the profile correlation; unreliable for drones, noise and atonal material
field_notes.true_peak_dbtp: ffmpeg ebur128 true peak; values > 0 mean inter-sample overs
